turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Coastal Comfort Mattress · AI Messaging Agent onboarding (week 2 of 4) · Tuesday, October 6, 2026

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: **Attendees:** [PERSON_1] (VP, Ecommerce & Marketing), Darnell Wright (Contact Center Director), [PERSON_2] (Retail Operations Analyst), [PERSON_3] (CSM, Invoca), [PERSON_4] (Solutions Consultant, Invoca)

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Summary

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Met with the Coastal Comfort team for week 2 of the AI Messaging Agent onboarding. [PERSON_4] walked through the SMS follow-up templates she configured, and we reviewed AI Voice Agent results from the first month. We also talked through weekend staffing in the Tampa center and scheduled next week's session.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Discussion

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] kicked off with first-month AI Voice Agent numbers: roughly 1,530 calls handled across the 64 showrooms, with the strongest volume on store-hours questions and order status.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Billing setup and the Amazon Connect mapping were confirmed as working; no changes needed there.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Darnell flagged that Coastal is short two weekend agents in the Tampa center through November and is actively hiring. He asked whether the messaging templates could mention upcoming weekend hours, and [PERSON_4] said we'd look at the calendar logic.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_4] showed the follow-up templates side by side with the voice agent's transfer rules so the team could see where the two touch the same caller.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] asked about the monthly reporting cadence for messaging; we'll bring a sample view to week 3.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Next week we'll cover reporting, transcript review, and the ZIP-based template request.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Product feedback

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] wants the AI Messaging Agent to send the nearest showroom's address and hours in the follow-up text, based on the caller's ZIP.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Darnell said the AI Voice Agent is now answering about 40% of order-status calls without a transfer, which is ahead of their target.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Risks

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Two weekend agent openings in the Tampa center through November could slow follow-up on transferred calls if volume spikes.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Next steps

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_3] to confirm whether ZIP-to-showroom lookup can be supported in the messaging follow-up flow and report back to [PERSON_1] by Friday, October 9.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_4] to bring a sample monthly reporting view for messaging to the week 3 session on Tuesday, October 13.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] to send current weekend-hours calendar to [PERSON_4] by Thursday, October 8.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Darnell to share updated hiring timeline once the two weekend roles are filled; [PERSON_3] to check in on Friday, October 16.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_3] to send recap notes and week 3 agenda by end of day Wednesday, October 7.
